name: print-social-red-crypto-story-set-with-photo-and-swap-ui
title: Red Crypto Story Set
whatItIs: Three story frames on a dark red vignette: a man in silhouette lit by red, a centre story with a swap-token phone UI, and a woman looking at her phone in red neon, each with a short white headline and message bar.
whatItMeans: Red neon photography feels cinematic and urgent, and the product story in the middle links people to the interface.
techniques: Photography lit in the brand red for cohesion
Lightweight white sans headlines with dimmed words
Middle story showing the product UI inside a device
Story chrome with a reply bar for realism

vocabulary.definition: Photos lit or graded in the brand colour.
Selected words set at reduced opacity within a headline.
The reply bar, progress lines and header of a story.
